events.verdict: Melton (GSW) crosses over between his legs, and the ensuing arm contact from Goodwin (PHX) is marginal. Goodwin then cleanly ties up Melton and a jump ball is correctly called.
Goodwin (PHX) brings his hand toward the ball during the jump ball, and the contact with Melton's (GSW) arm is marginal.
Gillespie (PHX) deflects the ball away from Spencer (GSW).
Brooks (PHX) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Moody's (GSW) right arm during his spin move.
Moody (GSW) legally contests Brooks' (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Horford (GSW) establishes a wide screening position in Goodwin's (PHX) path, and the foot-to-foot contact is marginal.
Ighodaro (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball as he defends Spencer (GSW).
O'Neale (PHX) maintains verticality as he defends Melton's (GSW) shot attempt.  O'Neale also avoids making any contact with Melton's head as he defends the shot.
Melton (GSW) and Gillespie (PHX) come together at the same spot off-ball and the contact is marginal.
Melton (GSW) and Brooks (PHX) briefly engage and disengage after the expiration of the pick.
Horford (GSW) legally contests Gillespie's (PHX) shot attempt, which is cleanly blocked by Moody (GSW).
O'Neale (PHX) moves alongside Santos' (GSW) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Goodwin (PHX) makes contact with the ball after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Moody (GSW) makes contact with the ball as he defends Brooks' (PHX) drive.
Melton (GSW) directly contests Brooks' (PHX) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Brooks' hand after the release.
Goodwin (PHX) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Melton's (GSW) hand that is on the ball.
Horford's (GSW) right foot does not step on the baseline while he is in possession of the ball.
Gillespie (PHX) and Moody (GSW) both make contact with the ball as they attempt to secure possession.
Moody (GSW) loses his balance on his own, and any contact from Brooks (PHX) is marginal.
